typedModel: DRW_Material now exposes presence/default state for Materials Anonymous, global illumination/final gather modes, procedural-table end marker, and uniquely mapped late fields.
Copy/reset behavior includes the added typed values, presence flags, and parser context markers.
parser: Groups 293 and 292 enforce the DXF Boolean domain; 272/273 are routed according to the MATERIAL context.
Group 300 establishes generic-procedural context and group 292 closes it; the mixed procedural payload remains in the ordered raw-net.
After the end marker, groups 270/148/468/93/94 populate uniquely mapped fields with finite-real checks for 148/468.
Late groups 90 and 149 remain untyped because authoritative DXF evidence conflicts.
writer: Typed writer emits the authored unique tail fields in schema order and refuses invalid finite/domain state or late fields without a procedural-table end marker.
A complete typed generic-procedural table writer is not implemented.

generatedControls: ASCII and Binary generated MATERIAL streams verify procedural group order and that reused post-boundary fields do not overwrite Normal Map state.
Malformed Boolean groups 293/292 and non-finite late reals 148/468 are rejected.
Typed writer tests verify unique tail order and invalid-state refusal; generated parsing checks following LINE alignment.
Copy/reset checks cover defaults and presence flags. No persistent DWG/DXF fixture is added.
